s2.ptxt: Place both hands on the front of the cover and lift it upward to disengage the 2 front clips, then continue lifting upward to disengage the 1 rear clips, and remove the V-bank cover.

atten3.ptxt: Pulling up the front and rear at the same time may cause damage.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 9 clips and the radiator upper air deflector.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 clips and the engine under cover rear RH.
Put a tool on the pulley set bolt of the tensioner, and turn the tensioner counterclockwise to loosen the tension.

item.ptxt: Performing this from under the vehicle may damage the tensioner.
The pulley set bolt has a left-hand thread, so turning it clockwise loosens the pulley set bolt.

s2.ptxt: Using a 5mm hexagon wrench, fix the tensioner as shown in the illustration and remove the belt.
